_note: The popTo matching rule — see README.md. paths = the back-stack's concrete frame paths (root → top; null = a pathless frame, which never matches). expect = the matching index (deepest wins), -1 = no match. Query strings strip from BOTH sides before comparing; matching is concrete string equality, never a route pattern.

cases.name: frame carries a query, bare target still matches
bare frame, query-carrying target still matches
different query values on both sides still match (query-insensitive)
pathless frames never match a real target
query-only target strips to empty and never matches
top-frame match reports the top index (the runtime then no-ops)
deepest wins across query variants of the same page
